display.name: CircleCI
display.blurb: Inspect pipelines, workflows, and jobs, trigger and rerun runs, and read insights — authenticated with a personal API token brokered by the egress proxy.

cli.doc:
Use `circle` to drive CircleCI from this session — inspect pipelines, workflows, and jobs, trigger and rerun runs, and read insights. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects a personal API token in the `Circle-Token` header on every request to circleci.com; `CIRCLECI_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT run any login or set a real token.

Projects are addressed by a project slug `<vcs>/<org>/<repo>`, where `<vcs>` is `gh` (GitHub) or `bb` (Bitbucket) — e.g. `gh/acme/widgets`.

Identity check: `circle whoami` (GET /me).
Project: `circle project <slug>` — project details (requires `projects:read`).
Pipelines: `circle pipelines <slug>` lists a project's pipelines; `circle pipeline <pipeline-id>` shows one; `circle pipeline-workflows <pipeline-id>` lists its workflows (requires `pipelines:read`). `circle trigger <slug> [branch=main] [field=value …]` triggers a new pipeline (requires `pipelines:write`).
Workflows: `circle workflow <workflow-id>` shows one; `circle workflow-jobs <workflow-id>` lists its jobs (requires `workflows:read`). `circle cancel-workflow <workflow-id>` and `circle rerun-workflow <workflow-id> [field=value …]` (requires `workflows:write`).
Jobs: `circle job <slug> <job-number>` job details; `circle artifacts <slug> <job-number>` lists artifacts (requires `jobs:read`). `circle cancel-job <slug> <job-number>` (requires `jobs:write`).
Insights: `circle insights <slug>` workflow metrics (requires `insights:read`).
Passthrough: `circle get <path>` / `circle api <METHOD> <path> [field=value …]` for any v2 endpoint (path is relative to /api/v2, e.g. `circle get me`). Calls to a path your profile didn't grant are denied at the network boundary.
